programme.title: 好劇連場: 一起深呼吸
programme.desc: 一起深呼吸由戚薇楊祐寧主演，以中國醫生到海外援助其他國家為背景，當中不乏逼真的醫療手術畫面故事講述一支中國援外醫療隊剛剛抵達劄爾島，便遇上了突發地震，眾人立即展開救援華裔醫生李天成登島參加前女友凱莉和好兄弟喬向晚的訂婚宴，出於職業本能，果斷加入醫療隊，投入到了搶救工作中醫療隊的婦產科醫生周悅有著豐富援外經驗的李天成和理性冷靜的外科醫生廖宇等人，在嚴峻的援助形勢和巨大的文化差異下，衝破重重阻礙，開展了醫療救援和醫學科普等行動在援劄期間，援外醫生們用精湛的醫術和過人的勇氣，與當地富紳展開了驚心動魄的較量，找到了疫苗失活的真相，並成功阻止了一場可怖瘟疫的爆發，在救死扶傷的同時贏得了當地島民的尊重經歷了心理和情感的風雨歷練，周悅和李天成在醫治患者的同時也療愈了自己內心的傷痛，真正體悟了希波克拉底誓言的深層含義，更加堅定了拯救患者生命的決心，兩人亦攜手，在而後的援助醫療道路上結伴同行

programme.desc: 570만 관객동원의 대박 흥행작. 신현준, 김원희, 탁재훈이 확실하게 웃겨준다. 정준호, 현영 등 코믹 까메오들을 보는 재미도 쏠쏠. 2002년 개봉되어 무려 530만의 관객을 동원했던 lt가문의 영광gt 이후 3년만에 등장하는 속편. 전편이 서울대 출신의 엘리트 사위를 맞이면서 벌어지는 이야기였던 반면, 이번 속편은 서울지검 강력계 검사 며느리를 맞이하면서 벌어지는 여수 조폭 집안의 좌충우돌 소동을 코믹하게 그렸다. 여검사 역에 김원희가, 그녀와 사랑에 빠지는 맏형 역에 신현준이, 그의 두 동생 역에 탁재훈, 임형준이, 그리고 이들 세 형제의 어머니이자 백호파 대모 홍덕자 여사 역에 김수미가 출연한다.

programme.desc: 우리 민족은 기록에 관해서는 대단한 저력을 지니고 있다. 유네스코에 세계문화유산으로 지정된 조선시대의 승정원일기가 그렇고 그 사초를 바탕으로 편찬한 조선왕조실록이 그렇다. 현대 의회 민주주의의 전당, 국회에도 이러한 기록에 있다. 국민의 대표기관인 국회의 의정활동을 낱낱이 기록하는 속기록이 바로 그것. 여의도 국회 30주년을 맞아 국회방송에서는 총 16부에 걸친 연작 다큐멘터리 다시보는 속기록연출 조정훈을 제작, 방송한다. 이 프로그램은 질곡의 대한민국 현대사를 국회 속기록이라는 프리즘을 통해 재조명하고, 우리에게 주는 질책과 교훈을 담아낼 계획이다.

programme.desc: 아기공룡 둘리quot를 1983년부터 10년간 보물섬에서 연재하던 원작자 김수정씨는 국산 만화 캐릭터를 지속적이고, 세계적인 캐릭터로 성장 시키기 위해서는 조직적인 활동의 필요함을 느끼고 1995년 2월에 주둘리나라를 설립했다.1996년 7월 장편 만화영화 quot아기공룡 둘리quot를 제작하여 COEX 외 전국 극장에서 상영했으며 현재 미라클에서 비디오 테이프제작 판매중이다.1999년 1월 17일 베를린을 시작으로 독일극장에 상영했었고, 독일 영화개봉에 맞춰 음반 및 비디오, 게임도 같이 판매하는 큰 성과를 올렸다.

programme.title: 大漢盛世
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 步步驚心
programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.desc: 張曉的命運被一場車禍徹底改寫她看著失控的卡車將自己的靈魂撞出了軀體，而她沒有進醫院也沒有進天堂，卻是被撞進了清朝的宮廷中就像穿越小說裏寫的那樣，張曉的靈魂跨時間隧道，一個叫若曦的十六歲清朝女孩的體內重生一場震動歷史的九龍奪嫡正暗潮湧動權利的廝殺，愛情的灼燒，被無限放大的歷史舞臺上，若曦的命運無可避免的與眾位阿哥們交織在一起她知道自己不該捲入這場九王奪嫡爭鬥中，可心不由己，因為這裡有所愛的，也有愛她的若曦最後選擇的是溫潤如玉的八阿哥，還是面冷心熱的四阿哥，又或是出人意料的其他人？

programme.title: 老子李耳傳
programme.desc: 該劇講述了東周末年，亂世紛爭，老子一生學道悟道得道傳道，歷經磨難寫成道德經的傳奇故事

programme.title: 包青天
programme.desc: 宋仁宗年間，開封府尹包拯，通稱包青天，為官清廉，為民伸冤，強調人在做天在看舉頭三尺有神明不畏強權，除惡務盡

programme.title: 善德女王
programme.desc: 利用美色掌握宮中權力的美室，一心想成為王后，雖然摩耶王后在她的詭計下死裡逃生，還身懷六甲回到宮中，但摩耶王后懷的雙胞胎卻成就不幸的宿命，因為王室流傳一個預言御出雙生，聖骨男盡，意指王室若生出雙胞胎，將使王室男性斷了精氣真平王深知要是王后生下雙胞胎的事實曝光，一家人將會有無止盡的災難，於是命宮女昭火偷偷將其中一個女兒帶出王宮多年後被拋棄的公主德曼回到新羅，與雙胞胎姐姐天明公主同心協力對抗美室美室企圖用各種手段羅織罪名於德曼公主和天明公主，天明公主於一場追捕德曼的陰謀計畫下意外身亡，原本只想逃出新羅的德曼公主因為天明公主的死開始藉著聰慧的頭腦與身旁各方勢力的協助，最終擊垮政敵美室，成為第一個登上新羅王位的女性

programme.title: 大漢盛世
programme.desc: 鐵腕定江山，仁德治天下，開創大漢文景盛世氣象西元201年，布衣天子劉邦擊敗西楚霸王項羽，建立了大漢王朝為鞏固皇權，誅滅韓信英布等異姓功臣，並應對匈奴威脅呂后專權後朝政動盪，直至誅呂之亂，性情仁厚長期鎮守代地的劉恒被推立為帝，是為漢文帝文帝即位後，以仁政安民，推行輕徭薄賦與民休息，抑制功臣與諸侯勢力，整頓吏治，重用賢才，推動農業與法制改革，同時安撫邊疆抵禦匈奴在權力與親情間多有取捨，含淚處置親族以穩國本最終奠定文景之治基礎，使漢室走向長治久安

programme.title: 黃飛鴻三之獅王爭霸
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻偕同十三姨梁寬赴京城與父親黃麒英相敘，並協助開辦寶之林藥廠事宜獅王大會即將舉行，惡霸趙天霸視黃飛鴻為大患，邀黃飛鴻談判時設下重重陷阱欲置黃死地，幸虧黃麒英一干人趕到支援，解除困境趙霸天咄咄逼人，逼使黃飛鴻不能袖手旁觀，決定挺身而出，阻止趙天霸此等敗類奪取獅王美名

programme.title: 法海：白蛇傳說
programme.desc: 藥師許仙採藥途中偶遇修煉千年的白蛇，一人一妖互許終身豈料白蛇卻在兩人飲酒慶祝後現出原形，遭不知情的許仙用法刀刺傷，且負傷離去許仙得知真相後悔恨不已，前往雷峰塔盜取仙草拯救白蛇，卻遭妖靈附身而被高僧法海帶往金山寺服下仙草功力倍增的白蛇怒闖金山寺想帶走許仙，與法海展開一場死鬥

programme.title: 竊聽風雲
programme.desc: 香港警務處刑事情報科竊聽小組三位成員潛入上市公司，針對金融公司非法操控股價一事進行調查，沒想到值勤時竊聽到一則意外情報，面對巨額利潤，三人正直的信念動搖，決意趁機在風起雲湧的股市大賺一筆，再以職務之便銷毀罪證正當三人準備全身而退，這小小的貪念卻掀起一陣滔天巨浪，更引來殺身之禍

programme.title: 花田囍事
programme.desc: 小霸王周通與妹周吉時常惹事淩人，其母太君為使二人定性，決要二人各自成親吉與指腹為婚的林嘉聲被迫入贅周家，林嘉聲於洞房夜逃走，巧遇母夜叉相助通找魔術師高柏輝於太君壽宴中表演，正值花田燈會中，輝邂逅白家獨女白雪仙，通偶然得睹雪仙芳容，驚為天人，硬要娶雪仙過門，於重重誤會下，弄成笑話百出

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記之魔教教主
programme.desc: 改編自金庸武俠小說倚天屠龍記父母雙亡的張無忌（李連杰飾）身中玄冥神掌，幸得明教聖女小昭（邱淑貞飾）相助，練成九陽神功與乾坤大挪移，爾後得悉蒙古郡主趙敏（張敏飾）欲殘殺明教之奸計，遂赴光明頂揭穿其陰謀，終成為明教教主

programme.title: 唐伯虎點秋香
programme.desc: 姑蘇唐伯虎（周星馳飾）文名遠播某日，唐伯虎在大廟中遇見華夫人及侍婢秋香（鞏俐），一見傾心，不惜以假身分華安賣身葬父入華府為僕豈知華夫人因故痛恨唐家，並對華安之來歷起疑，幾經波折後終於識破其真實身分為唐伯虎，但仍心存刁難，且看唐伯虎能否在一班蒙面新娘中點中秋香

programme.title: 空氣殺人首
programme.desc: 創傷中心醫師面對愛妻因為不明肺病死亡兒子性命也岌岌可危的情況下，想做些什麼卻又束手無策原為檢察官的小姨子，在姐姐死後成為律師，誓言要為姐姐的死討回公道兩人聯手調查相關醫療事件，發現真凶竟是添加在加溼器裡的殺菌劑！為了向世人揭發真相，兩人集結受害者家屬，向殺菌劑的製造企業提出控訴

programme.title: 異度空間
programme.desc: 擁有陰陽眼的章昕不堪其擾決定求助心理醫師Jim，Jim認為章昕所見的靈異現象是因孤單產生的幻覺，想盡辦法助她擺脫纏身多年的夢魘兩人在療程中情愫漸生，章昕痊癒之際卻發現Jim的行為異常，深入調查後發現所有怪異行徑都與他深埋內心不可告人的可怕經歷有直接關係，這次能否換章昕用愛幫助Jim逃離惡夢？

programme.title: 終極部隊
programme.desc: 妻子和女兒在銀行搶案中遭到劫持，前特種部隊戰士挺身而出，他成功擊潰劫匪，但保險庫中被盜取的致命性毒素，卻讓數百萬人的生命陷入岌岌可危的險境

programme.title: 醉後的浪漫
programme.desc: 宰勳（金來沅 飾）與未婚妻分手之後，夜夜買醉借酒澆愁，一日宿醉醒來後發現前晚與某人通話了兩個小時，而通話對象竟是昨日新來的女同事善英（孔曉振 飾）；更尷尬的是，宰勳前一晚不小心撞見善英與男友的分手場面！從此兩人之間總是有著微妙的緊張氣氛，但隨著對彼此越來越了解，愛情也悄悄在他們心中萌芽

programme.title: 葉問：終極一戰
programme.desc: 患有胃病的葉問，於1949年隻身前往香港謀生在港九飯店職工總會天台開始教授詠春的他，獲得了一班新收徒弟這班徒弟中，任職警察的鄧聲因鎮壓罷工的工人，被逼著與同門師弟妹梁雙李瓊陳四妹等人為敵葉問的妻子張永成，在這期間從佛山來港團聚，未料香港的生活讓夫妻倆的相守之路越陷艱難

programme.title: 黃飛鴻II之男兒當自強
programme.desc: 黃飛鴻與十三姨梁寬在廣州遇到白蓮教徒借扶清滅洋口號，搗亂使館教堂等洋人地盤，連就讀洋校的小學生也不放過，原來是大臣納蘭元述包庇用來對付革命黨黃在一醫學會議中，與革命領袖孫文一見如故，發覺他們對救國更具遠見，決助他們一把逃過厄運，但白蓮教徒卻苦苦相逼

programme.title: 家有囍事
programme.desc: 常家三兄弟與父母同住在祖產大屋中老大常滿外遇情婦Sheila致其妻程氏離家出走老二常騷為一偏向女性化之男子，與偏向男性化之表姑媽梁無雙水火不容老三常歡為電台DJ兼花花公子，與影癡聽眾何里玉發展出戲劇化戀情三對歡喜冤家一路鬧出了不少笑話，最後大團圓結局收場

programme.title: 賭神3之少年賭神
programme.desc: 六八年夏天，姓高紗廠老闆敗賭而致家破人亡他的八歲兒子高進從此喪失家園，加入了老千集團跟靳學一切千門技術，十七歲已成為獨當一面的老千高手後來在一次賭神大賽中被師父出賣，並遭槍擊，好友七姑娘與于於在混戰當中受了重傷，高進在連番打擊下決定與師兄傲及靳在賭場上決一死戰

programme.title: 逃學威龍
programme.desc: 警署即將退休的黃局長因失去佩鎗，懷疑是遭曾到警署參觀的中學生偷走，遂暗中派飛虎隊員周星星（周星馳飾）及老牌臥底曹達華（吳孟達飾）潛入學校臥底伺機尋回失鎗在學校裡假扮父子的兩人與輔導老師何小姐（張敏飾）一班學生及黑社會勢力將會在校園中引起何等風波？

programme.title: 逃學威龍2
programme.desc: 周星星（周星馳飾）和曹達華（吳孟達飾）因立功得見上司黃蓮如（葉德嫻飾）研究升職事宜黃對達之正義勇敢極為欣賞，提升為重案組，但對星之輕浮不滿而調往當交通差達獲委以重任再度進入學校臥底調查恐怖分子活動，星亦以個人身份進入學校臥底協助達調查過程中，星發現一女孩Sandy（朱茵飾）可能與此案有關，故假意結識，怎料Sandy竟對星產生愛意，令已與何老師論及婚嫁的星進退兩難

programme.title: 龍馬精神
programme.desc: 昔日風光的龍虎武師老羅（成龍飾），如今窮困潦倒，與他的愛馬赤兔相依為命，在片場靠著跑龍套過日子老羅一心想將赤兔培養成動作巨星，然而天外飛來橫禍，老羅與赤兔無端身陷官司，只能求助於多年未見的女兒小寶與其律師男友乃華與此同時，有人上傳了老羅與討債集團的追逐戰影片，精彩的武打動作在網路瘋傳，老羅更獲得拍電影的機會，女兒小寶還幫忙當起了製作人，試圖為老羅與赤兔爭取最好的動作舞台

programme.title: 人潮洶湧
programme.desc: 小劇場演員陳小萌的人生窮困潦倒，事業一敗塗地，有一天，他去澡堂泡澡，竟意外的讓殺手周全摔倒失憶，演員和殺手交換了身分，從醫院醒來的殺手失去記憶，誤以為自己是走投無路的演員，在偶然結識的單親媽媽李想的幫助下，他重新認識作為演員的自己，探索前進的方向，在這過程中他和李想的內心也悄悄發生變化

programme.title: 玩命飆速
programme.desc: 聽聞弟弟的死訊後，龍什回到老家，想親自尋找兇手報仇他發現飆車族午夜小隊的頭目眼鏡蛇與他弟弟的死有關但他必須跟他們比賽飆車，才有復仇的機會接著龍什找到改車王泰克，請她幫忙改造重機，他才能在競賽中與眼鏡蛇一較高下然而，當三合會得知龍什會破壞他們的行動時，也從中作梗，阻止他參賽龍什必須突破重圍，用他的拳頭進行報復

programme.title: 戰狼堡壘1：守門人
programme.desc: 2039年的未來，世界秩序分崩離析，各國的盟約規則平靜生活全都搖搖欲墜，世界正面臨全新的戰爭2039年的戰狼部隊將投入一個遭受全新邪惡科技所掌控的新世界，由卡謬布拉塔夫所率領的戰狼部隊轉而成為秘密行動組織，他將首次面對超乎理解的未知敵人

programme.title: 戰狼堡壘2：襲擊者
programme.desc: 因一場行動失去戰袍而悲痛萬分的戰狼部隊，必須設法找出神秘的攻擊者，並要面對敵人強大的軍事武裝設備

programme.title: 戰狼堡壘3：戰俘
programme.desc: 被戰狼部隊逮捕的神秘首領，因審訊的過程引起爭議，讓所有人群起反對卡謬，然而即將發生的危機卻遠比想像中更接近戰狼部隊

programme.title: 終極殺陣：最後衝刺
programme.desc: 隨著孩子出生長大家計吃緊，廢材警探艾米里決定接下史上最艱難的任務－－押解國際恐怖份子到南非，不得不求助老拍檔丹尼爾共度難關正當兩人認真商討對策時，小兔崽子們也沒閒著，闖禍本領更勝老爸，蠟燭兩頭燒的兩人，這下不僅要身兼奶爸，還要阻止法國淪為國際笑柄！

programme.title: 美國天堂
programme.desc: 1951年，匈牙利陷入軍閥割據的全民恐慌，從事出版的彼得與瑪姬夫婦名列清算名單，他們逃亡至美國，卻無法帶走小女兒蘇珊平安抵達後，瑪姬不斷寫信向美國政府求情，只盼見到女兒全家團圓蘇珊由鄉間一對好心夫婦撫養長大，這天，城裡的奶奶要帶蘇珊進城玩，蘇珊將搭上飛往美國的班機，那裡有苦心企盼與她團聚的親生父母與嶄新生活小小年紀的蘇珊沒得選擇，美國不是她的家；她的心，始終遺留在遙遠的匈牙利

programme.title: 湯姆克魯斯：永遠的巨星
programme.desc: 湯姆克魯斯是1980年代好萊塢的指標性人物，雖然曾經歷職業生涯低谷，但他靠著搏命演出，重回演藝事業高峰，在這個充斥著超級英雄和奇幻系列電影的娛樂世界，湯姆克魯斯獨樹一幟，邁入演藝圈四十年的他，再次憑藉不顧生命危險的演出，成為票房之王，以此奠定他在娛樂圈甚至整個流行文化中不可取代的地位

programme.title: 極限遊戲
programme.desc: 被構陷入獄的凱柏（傑瑞德巴特勒飾）在極不情願下，成為流行文化界的超級英雄：全球數百萬粉絲每週上網爭相看他在科技天才肯尼卡索（麥可霍爾飾）所發明的超暴力線上遊戲天地逃殺中，和其他數百位受刑人，為求活命而真槍實彈廝殺有些人不以為然地斥責這款遊戲是利用高科技來奴役他人的傷天害理行為，而驍勇善戰的凱柏，自然成為他們心目中，唯一能撂倒卡索的關鍵人物

programme.title: 神鬼戰隊
programme.desc: 特種部隊隊長塞達爾因遭遇伏擊而失去了16名士兵，被撤職以示負責，然而，政府正處於內外受敵的狀況，副國務卿提議組織一個特殊小隊來處理這些叛變狀況塞達爾被賦予隊長的任務，由傑出士兵和警察組成的特殊團隊（T..M），不管是內部叛徒或是外人，都必須全面肅清內外受敵，他們組成一支魔鬼部隊誓死抗敵！

programme.title: 安娜
programme.desc: 盧貝松動作驚悚新作，地表最強女殺神誕生！一名謎樣女子，臥底黑白兩道，彈無虛發懲治惡徒，是當今世界上最令人恐懼的政府刺客在引人注目的美麗之下，深埋著極大秘密，眾人只知道她的名字叫：安娜

programme.title: 戰爭中的鬼故事首
programme.desc: 在二次世界大戰最黑暗的日子裡，五名美國大兵受命前往一座曾被納粹高級指揮官佔領的法國莊園當他們進入這座莊園後，竟開始經歷一連串難以解釋的靈異現象，讓他們的世界變得瘋狂這場難以脫逃的夢魘，似乎比戰爭所目睹事物都更加可怕

programme.title: 深入戰區
programme.desc: 一名母親偽裝成記者進入戰區，想要尋找被極端組織洗腦而離家加入反政府軍的兒子，但最後被庫德武裝分子包圍在民兵的伏擊下倖存的她，目睹了一場毀滅性的戰爭和痛苦的世界，但她對孩子的愛給了她戰勝一切的勇氣，唯一的信念就是活下去並把愛子帶回家

programme.title: 舞力重擊2
programme.desc: 年輕又才華洋溢的編舞家桑德爾，為了籌備一齣眾所矚目的百老匯新劇，找來了一位天賦異稟的現代舞舞者芭洛和一位技巧非凡的創新鋼琴家查理然而，過程中三人之間微妙的平衡逐漸起了變化，查理愛上了芭洛，而桑德爾也把芭洛視為自己的謬思女神，三人之間的情感和對立一觸即發，一場激情澎湃的舞蹈大戰即將展開

programme.title: 時空冒險
programme.desc: 1985年，冒險家喬納森丹格迫降在距離非洲海岸20英里的一座島上他必須在蘇聯截捷足先登之前，找到一座能他讓回到過去的神廟，以求改寫有關太空競賽美蘇冷戰甚至第二次世界大戰等重大歷史事件！

programme.title: 漫漫回家路
programme.desc: 5歲的薩魯布萊爾利，跟著媽媽和哥哥生活在印度的小鄉村某天他在火車站與著哥哥失散，輾轉被帶至千里之外的加爾各答在善心人士的協助之下，薩魯被一對遠在澳洲的夫婦收養，卻也讓他離家越來越遠25年後，薩魯開始按耐不住對原生家庭的思念，決定展開艱辛的尋根之旅，他憑著兒時零碎記憶，透過GoogleEarth模糊地形的拼湊，只為了重回母親的溫暖懷抱

programme.title: 戰狼堡壘4：準備行動
programme.desc: 為了接受治療，戰狼部隊反被捲入一場國際陰謀，他們必須和過去的戰友合作執行新的任務

programme.title: 戰狼堡壘5：最高機密
programme.desc: 戰狼部隊的成員們緬懷過去的日子，卡謬對所有人說出他埋藏多年的祕密同一時間，恐怖份子首腦哈辛的準備工作亦持續進行中

programme.title: 戰狼堡壘6：救贖之路
programme.desc: 恐怖份子首腦哈辛即將展開攻擊行動，戰狼部隊必須守護他們的秘密基地戰狼托米斯過往秘密揭曉，這群戰狼隨之將踏上未來救贖之途

programme.title: 追殺胖老爹
programme.desc: 聖誕老人克里斯（梅爾吉勃遜飾）隨著年紀增長，事業也跟著逐年下滑為了拯救聖誕工廠，並養活他的小精靈員工，他被迫與美軍合作，轉行開始製造軍武然而不過是一次失誤，竟讓他惹來殺身之禍？！原來就在聖誕節早晨，一位富家少爺滿心期待地打開聖誕禮物，卻發現禮物只是一塊煤炭，於是決定雇用職業殺手，獵殺這位讓他火冒三丈的聖誕老人！屁孩PK聖誕老人，這場佳節攻防究竟誰輸誰贏？

programme.title: 湯恩與劍客汪汪隊
programme.desc: 湯恩希望追隨父親的腳步，成為皇家劍客汪汪隊一員他前往巴黎冒險，遇見喋喋不休的老鼠皮普，並成了湯恩的隨從湯恩與貼身戰友經歷無數場戰役，不僅要力抗邪惡的紅衣主教及其黨羽，還要阻止英法爆發戰爭歷經了這些後，湯恩發現友誼和正義的寶貴價值湯恩最終能成為劍客汪汪隊的一員並贏得佳人的芳心嗎？

programme.title: 放牛班足球隊
programme.desc: 瑪麗娜是位相當不尋常的修女，她來到一所學校任職，學校收容許多單親失親的孩子她被分配到最不喜歡讀書的放牛班，孩子們一如既往地調皮搗蛋，想要逼退瑪麗娜修女儘管如此，瑪麗娜有個想法，想組建一支足球隊，幫助孩子們找到學習的重心

programme.title: 毀滅倒數
programme.desc: 不久的未來，漂泊的太空人大衛，正在外太空進行例行氣候視察一場失控的意外，讓大衛與太空船及地球指揮中心失去聯繫而此時的地球，機器人與人工智慧已經成為人們生活的好夥伴；科技的快速發展，讓人們可以重返並編輯自己過去的記憶租借身體，甚至高階的人類，更可以選擇讓自己長生不老只是，當仰賴的科技變成真實夢魘，世界即將在十分鐘內毀滅，人們還能掌控自己想要的未來嗎？

programme.title: 星光首映場戰爭中的鬼故事
programme.desc: 在二次世界大戰最黑暗的日子裡，五名美國大兵受命前往一座曾被納粹高級指揮官佔領的法國莊園當他們進入這座莊園後，竟開始經歷一連串難以解釋的靈異現象，讓他們的世界變得瘋狂這場難以脫逃的夢魘，似乎比戰爭所目睹事物都更加可怕

programme.title: 蓬門碧玉紅顏淚
programme.desc: 1930年代美國密西西比小鎮，年輕英俊的歐文前來執行鐵路公司的裁員任務，與房東的女兒艾娃墜入情網但歐文令小鎮多人失業而備受當地人士排擠，艾娃的母親亦從中作梗，迫使這對愛侶分離

programme.title: 無敵幸運星
programme.desc: 曹家大老爺去世，留下家族企業及遺產給在法國念書的女兒飛飛管理，飛飛的大哥及堂哥心懷不軌欲將遺產占為己有大哥無意間救起落海的鳳，發現鳳與飛飛長相一模一樣，讓鳳假扮飛回家星在夜闖曹家行竊時被逮個正著，情急之下謊稱暗戀飛多年，將計就計與堂哥合作打算與飛結婚，順理成章分遺產

programme.title: 荒野一匹狼
programme.desc: 南北戰爭結束不久後的美墨邊境小鎮外，一位拖著棺材漫步在泥濘荒野上的浪人姜戈，解救了一名原將被處以火刑的美麗女子瑪麗亞在這目無法紀的鎮上有著二股惡勢力，隨著姜戈偕瑪麗亞重回小鎮，是否將掀起更大的腥風血雨？而姜戈背後拖著的棺材裡又裝著什麼秘密？

programme.title: 特務迷城
programme.desc: 夢想成為特務的小北（成龍飾），從小習武且有一點預知能力，憑著特長幫忙逮捕了銀行搶匪，不料因此開啟尋親與繼承遺產之旅然而，這一切竟然與美國政府失竊的炭疽菌有關！？

programme.title: 摩斯拉
programme.desc: 因為在輻射汙染區發生船難，而意外發現原以為是無人島的神秘小島：嬰兒島當調查隊在島上遭遇危險時，幸得到兩名身高只有30公分的小美人搭救，然而貪婪的人類卻將之捉走並公開表演嬰兒島上的守護神摩斯拉前往日本搭救，人類動用原子熱能砲射擊在東京鐵塔下結繭的摩斯拉，原以為已成功消滅時，摩斯拉卻破繭而出，展動雙翅

programme.title: 新天龍八部之天山童姥
programme.desc: 巫行雲與李秋水互爭天山童姥之位，為了春秋所乘，幸在最後關頭，阿紫棄暗投明，與虛竹協助巫李兩人，卒能誅殺元凶，重建天山之祥和

programme.title: 教父
programme.desc: 二戰後的紐約黑手黨柯里昂家族，是以賭博走私和操控工會的黑幫企業，首領維多嚴守傳統黑幫道德準則，拒絕販售敗壞人心的毒品被人尊為教父而其他黑手黨家族為謀求更高利益的毒品生意，希望在警政界具影響力的維多加入經營被拒後，一場腥風血雨的黑幫血拚暗殺，正襲向維多的柯里昂家族

programme.title: 午夜密令
programme.desc: 1939年夏天，一間位在英國南部海岸專收納粹高官女兒的奧古斯塔維多利亞女子學院，嚴格遵循著希特勒的納粹思想英籍校長羅喬爾僱用英籍教師湯瑪斯米勒作為臨時教師；湯瑪斯並在校長與其他德籍教師們的監視下，教導這群女孩練習英語這時，校園中出現一位前任教師的屍體，也讓湯瑪斯陷入致命危機

programme.title: 黑夜看守人
programme.desc: 三位燈塔看守人在一座蘇格蘭的小島上進行為期兩個月的看守勤務，平靜的生活卻因為一艘擱淺的小船而變了調，他們在船上發現裝了大量黃金的箱子，原本與世無爭的他們因此陷入天人交戰，究竟該留下不義之財還是置之不理？同時，遺失黃金的罪犯們也盯上了他們，一場起於貪婪的腥風血雨即將在島上展開

programme.title: 地球攻擊命令：哥吉拉對蓋剛
programme.desc: 怪獸島上沉睡的哥吉拉意外甦醒後，被某兒童樂園人員抓走，原來他們是披著人類軀殼的蟲型外星人，因原生星球汙染而欲佔領地球，並喚來宇宙怪獸王者基多拉與改造生化獸蓋剛大肆破壞；而地球最終守護神哥吉拉也正帶著安基拉斯從怪獸島出發

programme.title: 新流星蝴蝶劍
programme.desc: 明朝中葉，東西兩廠明爭暗鬥東廠曹公公手下三大高手，孟星魂（梁朝偉飾）高老大（楊紫瓊飾）葉翔（甄子丹飾）情同手足，葉翔暗戀高老大，高老大卻對孟星魂情有獨鍾孟星魂與八卦門掌門之女小蝶（王祖賢飾）是愛侶，小蝶亦已懷有孟之骨肉四人在執行任務之際，面對糾纏的感情亦痛苦不已

programme.title: 日落黃沙
programme.desc: 20世紀初隨著鐵路貫穿美國東西部，傳統舊西部正在消失，由派克領導的搶劫集團決定幹下最後一票大搶案後收山，殊不知這是鐵路公司募集一群賞金獵人所設下的圈套事敗後倖存的五人越過邊境逃往墨西哥，墨國軍閥馬帕其提出豐厚條件請派克一夥去搶劫美軍的重武器為了金錢江湖道義與兄弟情誼，一場腥風血雨即將展開

programme.title: 花田囍事
programme.desc: 小霸王周通與妹周吉時常惹事淩人，其母太君為使二人定性，決要二人各自成親吉與指腹為婚的林嘉聲被迫入贅周家，林嘉聲於洞房夜逃走，巧遇母夜叉相助通找魔術師高柏輝於太君壽宴中表演，正值花田燈會中，輝邂逅白家獨女白雪仙，通偶然得睹雪仙芳容，驚為天人，硬要娶雪仙過門，於重重誤會下，弄成笑話百出

programme.title: 怪獸總進擊
programme.desc: 西元1999年，人類以高科技將地球十大怪獸集中在小笠原群島上，與人類和平共處某日黃色氣體籠罩全島，怪獸與控制中心的人類均不省人事不久後哥吉拉拉頓摩斯拉哥羅恐龍等怪獸在世界各國失控冒出大肆破壞！月光SY-3太空船被緊急派往月球探查，發現外星人弱點後化解危機；然而宇宙怪獸王者基多拉再次降臨，怪獸軍團們能否成功守護地球？

programme.title: 馬永貞首
programme.desc: 馬永貞和大哥一起離開家鄉闖蕩上海灘，因一身義膽豪情而受當地大老譚四爺所賞識，後偶遇歌女金鈴子並互生情愫，幾人在動盪的上海灘歷經江湖險惡，最終夢醒還鄉

programme.title: 被告人
programme.desc: 話題冠軍韓劇，正義檢察官池晟孤軍奮戰尋找真凶！！最強正義檢察官朴政宇，被冤枉殺害妻女入獄及事件發生後失去了記憶，成為了被告人為了洗刷背負的嫌疑罪名而不得不在獄中拼湊記憶與找出殺害妻女的真凶，這時他也進入人生最糟糕的兩難選擇，陷入檢察官的鬥爭中

programme.title: 紅色高跟鞋雙語版
programme.desc: 狠心母拋家嫁富豪 棄子重生 只為揭穿母親真面目一段因愛與慾望而撕裂的親情，點燃了跨越二十年的復仇烈火年輕時的熙瓊為追逐榮華，狠心拋夫棄子，投入舊情人赫相懷抱，卻一步步被權力與野心吞噬她的女兒珍瑪在父親離世母親棄養的陰影下成長，懷著深深怨恨潛入熙瓊身邊，以設計師與繼孫女的身分逐步揭穿母親的虛偽面具母女之間愛恨交織，真相與謊言親情與仇恨輪番交鋒，最終將迎來一場足以摧毀一切的命運對決

programme.title: 魔女之城雙語版
programme.desc: 婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱她們相互扶持攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 小歡喜
programme.desc: 望子成龍！ 都會家庭的高考大作戰 以三個家庭為主軸，方圓和童文潔一家三口，他們的兒子方一凡即將面臨高考，但父母的壓力與兒子的無憂形成鮮明對比，使得家庭關係逐漸緊張另一方面，單親媽媽宋倩與女兒喬英子的生活也充滿了挑戰，前夫的糾纏和女兒的叛逆讓她左右為難最後，季楊楊從小被寄養在舅舅家，父母突然的關懷讓他陷入矛盾，父親季勝利努力與他建立親子關係，但結果並不理想這些家庭的故事交織在一起，展現了現代都市生活中家庭親情和成長的種種困境和溫暖時刻

programme.title: 木蘭復仇記首
programme.desc: 家破人亡張天愛女扮男裝！逆襲成女元帥盛國公之女阿麥目睹至親慘遭滅門，女扮男裝隱姓埋名，從貧民窟設局保命到混入軍營浴血奮戰！她憑藉絕妙陣法與過人膽識，在硝煙中一戰成名，從柔弱孤女蛻變為令敵軍聞風喪膽的鎮北軍元帥面對深陷權謀的帝王情愛宿敵常鈺青的真心追求，阿麥看破情鎖，毅然拒入後宮，率領軍民駐守靖陽劃地獨立，霸氣活出不靠男人的大女主傳奇！

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 慘遭閨蜜心機暗算 朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇

programme.desc: 心機渣男出軌妻子閨蜜 為奪下豪門不擇手段！人人稱羨的模範夫妻申明燮與韓善珠，在紀念婚禮當天揭開了幸福假象出身豪門的善珠外表完美，內心卻藏著被背叛的恐懼；出身貧寒的明燮，靠婚姻翻轉人生卻陷入外遇泥沼而第三者尹美羅，不僅成為他的靈魂寄託，更在命運的捉弄下與善珠結為好友當真相逐步揭開，愛與恨正宮與小三的界線逐漸模糊，一場婚禮，也預告了一場悲劇的開始

programme.desc: Part two of two. The Go Jetters launch the Vroomster to investigate and soon realize that Glitchs face isnt carved into the mountainside at all, but moulded from mud - this is going to be easy to fix, right?

programme.title: Tarbela Dam, Pakistan
programme.desc: A G.O. Force is missing! The good news is that Jetpad has located it at the Tarbela Dam in Pakistan, but the bad news is that its in the not so capable hands of Grandmaster Glitch. The Go Jetters speed off to get the click on back, but its out of control -firing all kinds of weather, and Grandmaster Glitch doesnt know how to turn it off. As lightning strikes the Dam, threatening to flood the valley and hailstones flatten surrounding crops, the Go Jetters call for Click ons to defend the area

programme.title: Nia and the Unfriendly Elephant
programme.desc: Nia is excited about being asked to transport a new elephant to the animal park, but the animal is scared of steam trains.

programme.title: Train Fudge
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck take an unexpected train trip whilst on their quest to buy some fudge.

programme.title: Magic Panic
programme.desc: Umbrella needs Sarah and Ducks help after he promises to put on a magic show.

programme.title: Knitting
programme.desc: Stanley must teach his friends how to knit. They all knit so much they burst out the top of the community centre. Stanley repairs the roof with the groups knitting.

programme.title: Runaway Train
programme.desc: Stanley must deliver some parcels on the train but ends up delivering the wrong ones. After correcting his mistake, he has to muster the townsfolk to help stop his runaway train.

programme.title: It Was So Hot.. I Got Chicken Pox!
programme.desc: Wobbly teeth, hiccups, hay fever, and sneezy problems, the talking animals discuss all the things that make them unwell.

programme.title: Its Time to Bake Gingerbread Pandas
programme.desc: Its snowing outside, but JoJo and Gran Gran are cosy in the kitchen making gingerbread biscuits. JoJo knows exactly what shape to make. Theres plenty of help from Ned, Monty and Jared too.

programme.title: Born Yesterday
programme.desc: Dad pretends he was born yesterday. Bluey and Bingo have to guide him through his second day on Earth, especially when he discovers food is delicious and steals Luckys Dads pie.

programme.title: Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey cant get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: The Waiting Badge
programme.desc: When theyre accidentally shut in the shed, Duggee shows the Squirrels how to make the time pass with calm breathing and made-up games. The Squirrels cope so well. Does Duggee?

programme.title: The Cheerleading Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels find Duggees cheerleader pompoms, so he shows them his old moves. Time to practice: Duggee at the chess board, the Squirrels as a squad. Theres a big match ahead...

programme.title: Hey Quacky!
programme.desc: Worm and Ladybird wonder whats going on at Squirrel Club. Theres a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

programme.title: Christmas Island, Indian Ocean
programme.desc: Grand Master Glitch travels with his Grimbots to Christmas Island in the Indian Ocean in the hope of finding some festive cheer, even though its not Christmas Day. He is sorely disappointed when he finds himself on a tropical island with not a hint of Christmas in sight! Determined to have his Christmas Day, he sets about trying to spread his own festive cheer by covering the island in snow. But this means the islands Red Land Crabs cant get to the ocean to lay their eggs. As the crabs are in

programme.title: Gooseberry
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, its Gooseberry, singing a song about everything you have to do to become a Gooseberry Club member.

programme.title: Festive Special
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Carrot, Potato, Parsnip and Brussels Sprout perform the festive classic Auld Lang Syne - if Potato lands from the moon on time.

programme.title: Fruit and Veggie Friends Day
programme.desc: All the fruit and veggies in the supermarket are enjoying Fruit and Veggie Friends Day, but Evil Pea is determined to ruin it. After Supertato inadvertently stops her from taking the friendship cards and launching attacks with her pea shooter and freezy hose, Evil Pea tries to cover the party in ice cream. But when her plan goes wrong, shes rolled away on the ice cream tub, and Supertato saves her. Supertato has been trying to give her a friendship card all day long - Evil Pea furiously accepts

programme.title: Kite Plight
programme.desc: Supertato, Carrot and the Grape Kids are enjoying flying kites until Evil Pea arrives in her balloon and cuts them down so she can rule the supermarket skies! Supertato and Carrot must climb a display of chopsticks to retrieve the kites from the top. Evil Pea threatens to cut them down again, so Supertato and Carrot turn their kites into hang-gliders and embark on an epic aerial chase with Evil Pea, leading to her bursting her balloon on a chopsticks display sign. Supertato and Carrot land safel

programme.title: Greens
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, LaaLaa and Po pick delicious green beans. The Noo-Noo puts the beans into the Tubby Custard Machine and out comes tasty, green Tubby Custard!

programme.title: Whale
programme.desc: Yakka Dee! celebrates children communicating - because talking fills you up with whizz, pop, bang! In this episode, Dee encourages a friend to say whale and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We learn all about whales - swimming, leaping and diving. We see splashing whales, black and white whales and even meet a singing whale! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dees friend finally succeeds in saying todays word!

programme.title: Blue Skies Ahead
programme.desc: Why has the sky in OKIDO turned so red? With the help of Zim, Zam and Zoom, the friends go on a trip in the rocket to find out.

programme.title: Mojo Rocks
programme.desc: A rockslide blocks Ted the bus and his passengers in a mountain pass. Mojos mighty dozer top will make short work of those rocks... if Mojo and Bo can work together!

programme.title: Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but thats never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: The Midnight Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels have different ideas about what makes a good party. But the Squirrels have lots of ideas about what happens when the clock strikes twelve. Are they right?

programme.title: The Laughter Badge
programme.desc: From sensible chuckles and nervous giggles to Duggees infectious laughter, once everyone starts, its so hard to stop. What were they laughing about again? Anyone remember?

programme.title: Campfire Choir
programme.desc: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

programme.title: Ladybirds Gameshow
programme.desc: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

programme.title: Everglades National Park, Florida
programme.desc: The Go Jetters save the Florida Everglades when hungry alligators chase Glitchs picnic.

programme.title: Asparagus
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey to mind her manners at the table - theyre not animals. But when Bluey gets her hands on a stick of magic asparagus, she shows them everyones got a wild side.

programme.title: Easter
programme.desc: Its the night before Easter and Bluey and Bingo are worried the Easter bunny is going to forget about them like last year. Mum and Dad reassure the girls but when they wake up to no chocolate eggs, Bingo fears the worst. Luckily Bluey finds a series of clues and a treasure hunt throughout the house begins.

programme.title: Faceytalk
programme.desc: Bluey and Bingo love to video chat with Muffin and Socks so they can all draw pictures together. When Muffin wont give Socks a turn, the kids discover what happens when you hog.

programme.title: Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... hes just entered Ragdoll mode!

programme.title: Andy and the Prehistoric Picnic
programme.desc: Andy meets some peckish Pachycephalosaurus, a hungry T-rex and a pterosaur.

programme.title: Dinosaurs
programme.desc: Bella and Lift make a new friend with an awesome roar, Steggy the Dinosaur! Together, they visit Tincy in the Sing Song Forest for a dinosaur song.

programme.title: The Wisdom Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels see Duggee reading Wonderful Stories about Wise Animals and want to learn about wisdom and how they can become more wise. They find out that wisdom isnt just about facts and figures, but that its about good judgement and experiences too. They learn to plan ahead, concentrate on the task at hand, that sometimes big problems need a little help, to focus on the present and that good things come to those who wait. Thank goodness Duggee is so wise!

programme.title: The Listening Badge
programme.desc: After hearing a strange sound, the Squirrels turn to Duggee to help identify its source. They learn about sound waves, and that you can listen for different qualities in the sounds, such as if its loud, quiet, high or low. Describing the sound can help you work out where its coming from, so Duggee lets the Squirrels close their eyes as they listen to sounds and make their guesses.

programme.title: The Golden Lion
programme.desc: The Golden Lion is a bandit with good martial arts skills and often robs from the rich to help the poor. He is ambushed and attacked by a gang one night but luckily finds help from a master healer, who has to find a way to treat him while they are both being chased by the gang.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: Challenge of the Masters
programme.desc: Young Wong Fei Hung must prove himself worthy to be taught by Master Lu, who was also his fathers martial arts teacher. Although he is defeated in a competition, Wong Fei Hungs passion in Kung Fu finally moves Lu and allows him to become Lus disciple.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: An imperial minister Cheng betroths his pretty younger daughter, Ye, to his friends son, Mu. His wife however, refuses to let Ye marry before her elder daughter Yan, who is ugly and undesirable. Yan is asked to pretend as Ye to meet Mu but scares him away. A rich guy who likes Ye meanwhile pretends as Mu to attend the wedding...

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Torrent Of Desire
programme.desc: Rich playboy David is a drunk until he falls in love with a fashion model Dan Feng and marries her. Davids sister Mona is in love with his best friend Han Ming, who rejected her as he secretly loves Dan Feng as well. Out of jealousy and hatred, Mona lies to David about a fake affair between Han Ming and Dan Feng...

programme.title: Golden Swallow
programme.desc: A heroine finds herself in a love triangle with a swordsman and a warrior. They team up to conquer the evil forces of the martial arts world but she is unable to choose between both men even as they face a deadly duel.

programme.title: Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: Yun Fei Yang, a Wudang servant hiding his identity as the sect leaders illegitimate son, is framed by long-hidden enemies and branded a traitor after losing his father. Hunted by rival forces and stripped of his martial arts, he masters the legendary Tian Chan Gong and rises again to clear his name and settle a generations-old blood feud.

programme.title: The Kid With A Tattoo
programme.desc: Young Bao Tong witnesses the brutal murder of his kung fu master by a vicious villain. A large eagle tattoo on Baos chest was spotted by the killer as he escapes. Can Bao escape from the killer?

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: Tycoon Zhou is a playboy who is engaged to be married, but that did not keep him from working his charms on as many ladies as he can. He keeps a diary about his romantic escapades and soon, the women with whom he has been intimate with are being murdered one by one. Zhou becomes the number one suspect by the police but is the killer someone else?

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlongs younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles...

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: This is an epic tale set during the time of the Sino-Japanese war. A painter Yu saves a young girl, Lotus, who is being sold to a brothel. They fall in love, get married and settled in to a peaceful life. However, their life is soon shattered by the Japanese invasion and the brutal regime that follows...

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: Lady Of The Law
programme.desc: Chan, the chief of Wan Sheng Escort, is forced to raise his opponents son, Yim. While Chan forbids Yim to practice martial arts, Yim secretly learns it. Ten years later, a rapist appears and Yim is arrested by a lady constable as the suspect. The rapist turns out to be Chans elder son and Yim is framed by the Chans. Can Yim prove his innocence?

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Adapted from a chapter of the classic Chinese legend Investiture of the Gods, this is the story of Na Cha set 3000 years ago. After Na Cha sacrificed his life to save his parents, he is reincarnated with his spirit embodied in a lotus flower and is armed with two magic weapons to save the people from their despotic emperor.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: Jiang Xiao Yu is separated from his twin brother as a baby after his parents are murdered. He is taken by a couple to Villains Valley and raised to be a villain by a host of outlaws. Jiang leaves the valley to explore the world when he grows up. Will he be able to avenge his parents and meet with his twin brother?

programme.title: The Kingdom and the Beauty
programme.desc: Emperor Cheng Te meets country maiden Li Feng on a visit to Southern China. It was love at first sight and the Emperor leaves with a promise that Li Feng would be his empress. When he sends for Li one year later, she was too ill to withstand the arduous journey and arrives just in time to die in the arms of her beloved...

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: The Mermaid
programme.desc: Zhang and Jins daughter, Peony, are betrothed at birth but Jin objects to the engagement now. Zhang meets a carp spirit that looks exactly like Peony and they fall in love. When Justice Bao is asked by Jin to distinguish Peony from her replica, he decides to quit the case when he witness the true love between Zhang and the carp spirit.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s a-go-go era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Shaolin Abbot
programme.desc: Monk Chi San is sent by his Shaolin Master to learn a special kung fu skill from a Wu Dang priest. He gets embroiled in a fight between the Qing and Ming camps along the way, and has to gather disciples to rebuild the burnt Shaolin temple at the same time.

programme.title: Perfect Girls
programme.desc: Chi will inherit his dying grandfathers fortune with one condition he has to be married in a month, otherwise the money goes to his uncle, Robert. Chi falls in love with Siu Siu, but Robert intends to stop them by sending Moraine to seduce Chi. When Moraine decides to marry Chi for money, Robert stops her and reveals their plot.

programme.title: Loving You
programme.desc: A bad-tempered, womanizing cop who always neglects his wife is shot in the head as he hunts down a drug dealer. Though he miraculously survives, he must depend on his wife to nurse him back to health. During the recovery, he begins to re-evaluate his life and repair the damages of his broken marriage.

programme.title: Behind the Yellow Line
programme.desc: A fresh graduate, Paul, strikes up an acquaintance with a pretty young girl, Monica, on the metro. Monica is involved in a love affair with a married man while Paul is also pursued by a rich girl. When Paul vows his true love for Monica, she suggests playing hide-and-seek with him in the metro to decide if they are fated to be together.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Womens Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Meis father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Out of the Dark
programme.desc: An old lady died after mysteriously falling off a building and her ghost appears to haunt the place. This freaked out the security guards, who invite ghostbuster Leo and his female assistant to help. In the process, Leo finds out that the old lady was killed by her son and daughter in law. To rest her soul, Leo promises to bring the couple to justice.

programme.title: Faithfully Yours
programme.desc: Playboy Hong Kong Barber Happy Chan opens a fashionable new salon, right next to an old-fashioned Shanhainese barber shop. Its owner, Chuk, is furious at this development and starts a quarrel with Chan and his colleagues during the opening ceremony of his new venture Chuks pretty daughter, Ying, is forced to keep the peace. Chan and his friends all attempt to woo Ying, but end up getting drunk and falling asleep in her bedroom. Later, Ying discovers that she is pregnant but no one can remember

programme.title: Kowloon Walled City
programme.desc: Neng was a street fighter in Northeast China but decides to start a new life in Hong Kongs Kowloon Walled City. Unfortunately, he is implicated in the fights and conspiracies among the triad forces. When his good friend is hunted down by the triad, Neng must team up with the residents of Kowloon Walled City to fight back and save his friend.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: A rich man dies, leaving all his fortune to his daughter in his will, but his son and nephew want a piece of the pie. The nephew sends Vincent to steal the will and the son finds Fung, who looks like his sister, to get the will. Vincent plans to marry Fung for the fortune, but as the two fall in love, they decide to unveil the cunning schemes.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: The movie is adapted from a famous Japanese manga. 18-year-old Takumi delivers tofu in his fathers near-obsolete car every day and becomes a good racer with perfect drifting skill. Encouraged by his father, he joins a mountain race and unexpectedly wins it, making him famous overnight and leading him from one exciting race to another.

programme.title: Mr Vampire
programme.desc: Taoist priest Kou is assigned to re-bury a rich man, in the hope that the new tomb will bring further prosperity. When the corpse turns into a vampire and wreaks havoc in the village, his disciples are also hurt by the vampire and possessed by a female ghost respectively. How can Kou save his disciples and hunt down the vampire at the same time?

programme.title: Fierce Cop
programme.desc: To save his son who has been kidnapped by human traffickers, police officer Zhang relentlessly hunts them down and accidentally finds himself implicated in a major child abduction case. In the process, he teams up with a mysterious lady to crack the international crime syndicate and rescue his son.

programme.title: Sixty Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: Sing is a rich man studying abroad, but is so spoiled that he can never concentrate on his studies but spends his time flirting with girls. One day, Sing gets blown up by a mobster when he hooks up with his mistress, Silvia. This arrogant prankster is resurrected instead as an unbeatable cyborg with unique skills, a real job and a new true love.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: This is a remake of the original 1966 classic, Dragon Gate Inn. The country is being policed by the East and West Bureaus, whilst the Emperors eunuchs have attained much power and control. With all the corruption, Zhao teams up with a group of assassins to systemically kill the eunuchs in order to save the country.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: Hong Kong action cinema is famous for its real kung fu moves performed by a group called Kung Fu Stuntmen. This docu-film pays tribute to the generations of kung fu stuntmen, with the crew spending over two years digging archives and interviewing many talents, including the most prominent masters like Jackie Chan, Donnie Yen and Sammo Hung.

programme.title: Whisper of Silent Body
programme.desc: Renowned as the corpse whisperer, forensic pathologist Qin Ming uncovers vital clues from the corpses. During a homicide investigation, he unravels a murder case sixteen years ago in the snowy mountain with his assistant and a detective. Together, they unveil the secrets of the mysterious homicide.

programme.title: Royal Tramp
programme.desc: Wei Xiao Bao is sent by a revolutionary group to be a spy in the imperial palace and find The Sutra of 42 Chapters. Xiao Bao soon befriends Emperor Kang Xi but must carry out his mission at the same time, so he is caught between two camps.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily, leading to the teams downfall. When an inexperienced virtual car racing champion joins the team and unexpectedly shines in a real-life race, can the three drivers team up to regain glory for their team?

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: Ting Ting is a student in an all-girl high school. She tries out for the schools stage production of Romeo and Juliet with an all-boy school and promptly falls for the lead, Jackson. While Ting Ting is swept away by the excitement of her first love, Jackson turns out to be more of a player than a partner.

programme.title: Casino Tycoon
programme.desc: Inspired by the story of Macaus Casino King Stanley Ho, the movie traces his blood-splattered fight to the top from 1930s to 1960s. In 1941, a young graduate, Benny Ho, flees Hong Kong during the Japanese invasion and heads for Macau. Benny starts as a labourer but rises to the top of the citys casino business with his courage, wisdom and diligence.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: A heroic tale about Hong Kongs brave firefighters. These courageous men can march into disastrous firegrounds and risk their lives to save others. However, do they have the same courage to confront their personal issues?

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: King Kong comes to Hong Kong in THE MIGTHY PEKING MAN, a uniquely Shaw Brothers spin on the ageless theme of beauty and the beast. The beast, seven stories high and hailing from the Himalayas, makes his way to the jungles of India in the wake of a violent earthquake. The beauty is Russia starlet Evelyne Kraft, a sexy blonde Tarzanette who is the Mighty Peking Mans best friend. Both are discovered by Danny Lee, a handsome young explorer who brings the odd couple back to Hong Kong, where Evelyne

programme.desc: Lonely cop Wong Wai Yip unknowingly saves the life of ruthless crime leader Hon Kong after a violent shootout. Soon after, a string of brutal murders shocks the city, forcing Wong to confront the truth behind the crimes. Consumed by guilt and haunted by his inner demons, he is pushed toward madness and must battle evil with evil.

programme.desc: Bored of the viewing options on window, Thunk realizes what hes been missing real life drama! But when Thunk starts creating drama around the farm, the others set out to teach him a lesson.

programme.desc: Following the events of the feature, Yi struggles to recreate her violin magic without Everest. While her mom and NaiNai prepare for the grand opening of their family dumpling shop, Yi, Jin, and Peng discover that Yis violin has attracted a magical bird-like creature, Fenghuang, who needs their help. Yis music also calls on Everest, who returns to join the crew and find Fenghuang a suitable home.

programme.title: Welcome Home, Everest!
programme.desc: While Yi and the crew try to pinpoint how Yis magic works, they notice that Everest isnt looking too hot. In fact, hes too hot. The crew tries everything to cool him down, even begging their old foe, Burnish, for help. Out of options, Yi tries to use her magic to send Everest home until Burnish and his jerboa sidekick, Duchess, reveal that theyve made over the kids rooftop fort into a high-tech HQ, complete with various tech gadgets for the crew and a temperature-controlled chamber for Ev

programme.title: Chore Score Dew Drop Swap
programme.desc: On Harpers first allowance day, the pets accidentally knock Harpers Piggy Bank over and lose one of her quarters that she was reserving to buy Nicholas an ice cream cone. Now the Dew Drops must scramble to replace it! When the Dew Drops struggle to help their kids with tasks that are outside their usual fairy-bilities, they decide to swap kids for the day, but ultimately learn they re exactly where they need to be because they know their families so well!

programme.title: Welcome to Harmony Harbor
programme.desc: Ari moves in to Harmony Harbor, but notices something strange involving a group of kids, a Noodle Truck chef and her pet squirrel. After Ari discovers the secret of Team Zenko Go, he asks to join the crew. But first he must learn the importance of teamwork.

programme.title: Delivery Disaster Slippery Business
programme.desc: When Donnas delivery truck breaks down, its up to the crew to help Donna continue delivering packages to Harmony Harbors residents. When the crew takes on a mission to rescue a lost pet, Ellie must face her fears in order to help save the day.

programme.title: Revenge Of The Creature Catcher Slugby
programme.desc: Revenge of the Creature Catcher Casper, Mantha and Ra accidentally lead Jimmys father to the underworld.Slugby. To prove that the teachers havent gone soft, Alder and Dash stage a Slugby match.

programme.title: You Oughta Be In Pictures Crypt Critters
programme.desc: You Oughta Be in Pictures When Mantha sees a Deedstown mob attacking a group of fellow zombies, shes determined to lead them in a counterattack. Crypt Critters Mantha comes down with an embarrassing case of crypt critters, but refuses to go to the nurse.

programme.title: Game Show
programme.desc: Its Game Show Day in the dollhouse! Our wily and well-groomed host, CatRat, leads Gabby and Pandy around the dollhouse, where they compete in Gab-ified games, like Tushy Tunes on the butt xylophone couch and a cooking competition of Bakey with Cakey. They win tickets and trade them in for prizes at the end.

programme.title: Kitty Pirates
programme.desc: Gabby unboxes a pirate treasure map in the shape of the dollhouse a piece of it has been torn off. This must mean its time for a pirate treasure hunt in the dollhouse! Pirate Gabby and Pirate Pandy head out on their journey across the many lands of the dollhouse to find the Gabby Cats Treasure!

programme.title: Wheres The Party? The Noisiest Night
programme.desc: When Marcus loses an invitation to a birthday party and doesnt know where it will take place, the Dew Drops set out to find the location and get Marcus to the party on time. When Harper cant sleep because of a strange noise in her room, the Dews must figure out the source.

programme.title: Escape The Backpack Play Date
programme.desc: While helping Lola pack for her first day of camp, the Dews get stuck inside her backpack! Using the random items inside, the Dews get crafty in their attempt to break out. When Eden and Phoebe join Harper and Marcus for a playdate, the Dews disagree on what activity their kids should do, ultimately learning that there are lots of ways to play!

programme.title: Spark Bees Best in Show
programme.desc: The kids scare away a swarm of bees. But when they realize bees make the flowers happy, they hatch a plan to get them back! When Scallop makes a bad choice, Kelp helps her learn from her mistakes.

programme.title: Superfan Barb
programme.desc: Kelp and the rest of his friends put on a game of rainbow ball, but Kelp begins to wonder how well his special spark can help him truly measure up to his favorite player. When the underwater friends meet someone new, theyre reminded that their differences make them unique.

programme.title: New Hat, New Tag! Furry Tail Ending
programme.desc: When Tag worries that shes no longer a Go dog, Lady Lydia helps her find a new persona by helping Tag try on a bunch of different hats. Luckily, when a runaway puppy needs to be wrangled, and only the speedy Tag can catch him, Tag realizes she was a Go dog all along. Sergeant Pooch reads Scooch, Tag and Kit a story book during their sleepover. But when the last pages are missing, the three kids work together to make up their own ending to the story.

programme.title: Bigpaw, Big Problems Captain Scooch and Scally-Tag
programme.desc: Tag, Scooch and Kit think they found the perfect story for their newspaper: Bigpaw is in Pawston! But when they find out that Frank and Beans were lying to the town, they seek to uncover the truth and reveal it to everyone. When Sam Whippet sets up a pirate-themed race for the Race Cadets, pirate-loving Scooch takes on the role of captain. Tag struggles to take orders as first mate while helping Scooch navigate maritime obstacles and avoid the fearsome pirates.

programme.title: 正义女神Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. The story is sparked by a frame-up incident involving a master chef, which causes his daughter and five apprentices to ...

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. As they uncover a bond spanning 300 years, Song learns to embrace love, mend family ties, and discover where he truly belongs.

programme.title: 爱的荣耀Glory of Love
programme.desc: 一桩吸金诈骗案意外改变了三个女人的命运：有如大树般坚强的女性；如花般绽放的富家千金；也有如小草般的平凡女性借由三个女主角来传达自信勇气及自我价值的重要性，从爱出发能克服任何困境挖掘出无限潜能和力量！A money-driven fraud case unexpectedly alters the destinies of three women: a resilient woman resembling a sturdy tree, a wealthy daughter blossoming like a flower, and an ordinary woman akin to grass. These three heroines convey the message of self-worth, highlighting the importance of love in overcoming challenges and unlocking ones unlimited potential.

programme.title: 亦舞之城Second Chance Romance

programme.desc: 该剧改编自忘语的同名小说，讲述了一个普通的山村穷小子，偶然之下跨入一个江湖小门派，虽然资质平庸，但依靠自身努力和合理算计最后修炼成仙的故事Han Li, a poor boy from an ordinary mountain village, stumbles into the pugilistic world by chance. programme.title: 远方的家On the Way

programme.title: 恶战Once Upon a Time in Shanghai
programme.desc: 二十世纪初，各地劳动人口纷纷涌入高速发展之上海山东青年马永贞伍允龙 饰亦到上海当码头工人当时上海各帮派荼毒社会，其中较有正义感之龙七安志杰 饰 赏识马永贞胆识过人武技非凡二人惺惺相惜，成为好友龙七反对贩毒及向日军卖力，与斧头帮三大犯罪头子白癞痢陈观泰 饰笑面佛袁祥仁 饰仇老四冯克安 饰为敌，马永贞与他连手反毒，令三人怀恨于心马永贞与江湖卖艺的铁师父洪金宝 饰及其两个女儿铁梅蒋璐霞 饰铁菊胡然 饰成为邻居马永贞被铁菊的硬朗性格所吸引，而铁菊亦佩服马永贞的正义感，对他渐渐产生好感龙七则迷恋上歌女盛香君毛俊杰 饰，没想到日后竟因此而身陷险境斧头帮因不满龙七的嚣张跋扈，与日本间谍桥本密谋除掉他，龙七惨遭暗算马永贞的邻居亦遭受袭击，马永贞赶至时已尸横遍野，垂死的铁师傅告知铁菊被斧头帮掳走极度悲痛的马永贞为救铁菊，单人匹马闯入斧头帮老巢，决定用双手消灭国家的敌人社会的败类，为民除害!

programme.title: 成为饭吧A Good Supper
programme.desc: 乡下小火车站周围有一家挂着饭店招牌的破旧白米饭店女高中生英信虽然是高三学生，但为了饭店的生意，骑着自行车每天急急忙忙地往市场跑，这是为了给来饭店解决一顿饭的客人准备一顿既便宜又温暖的晚餐英信从小就跟饭店老板京秀学做饮食后来饭店还来了跟着离婚的父亲，一夜之间开始了农村生活的正勋...被妈妈爸爸抛弃，被老奶奶养大的五福...还有双职工夫妇所以晚上主要在饭店吃饭的多情...这些同龄人从小时开始长达12年的晚上都聚集在饭店里吃同一桌饭，铸就了比亲兄弟更亲密的情感，比家人更紧密的联系

programme.title: 猎罪图鉴 2Under the Skin II
programme.desc: 猎罪图鉴第二季将延续第一季的绘色显影，画见人心这一故事主轴，通过对画像的勾勒，洞悉人性的复杂模拟画像师沈翊刑警队长杜城等人组成的北江小分队，在第二季将继续拆解人性谜题，追击案件真凶The second season of crime investigative drama series Under the Skin sees Shen Yi, portraitist with the talent to accurately sketch and restore back the images of killers, and Interpol police captain Du Cheng, unite and work together again to hunt down killers and resolve crime cases.

programme.title: 灼灼韶华Wild Ambition Bloom
programme.desc: 1916年，褚韶华为救哥哥而嫁给陈记药铺大少爷陈大顺，她以诚信和出色的商业得到陈父的赏识，成为药铺管理人陈父和陈大顺意外去世后，陈二顺继承药铺并败光家财，药铺陷入绝境褚韶华在艰辛努力下，开了华顺药铺养活一家老小褚韶华后决意携手初恋情人夏初开启新生活，却遭陈二顺和陈母阻挠陈家被土匪洗劫一空，褚韶华也在这次劫难中失去女儿，伤心不已的她独自出走上海褚韶华在上海永新百货业绩突出，受经营奇才闻知秋之邀共同创业，逐步成长为胆略过人重诺守信的女商人This is the story of Chu, who came from a family of traditional Chinese medicine in the early years of China and her life revolving round three men - Xia Chu, Chen Da Shun, and Wen Zhi Qiu. Not succumbing to the unfair arrangements of the times and fate, Chu gradually ex...

programme.title: 型男大主厨Stylish Man
programme.desc: 台湾广受欢迎的常青美食料理节目，由2006年始播至今，2011年还获选金钟奖的最佳综合节目主持人奖每一期将有不同的主题：大明星來下廚由兩位明星或两个明星档分組對抗，拿出自己的拿手菜對抗比拼；五分钟出好菜由两位厨师根据指定食材，在五分钟内烹煮出易学美味的一道菜等这是一个富有娱乐效果的轻松美食节目，能够持续制作这么多年不是没有理由的

programme.title: 早餐中国第五季Breakfast In China S5
programme.desc: 早餐中国第5季，30种热气腾腾的早餐，30种人生况味我们依然在拍摄那些微不足道的民间食物，依然在见证那些触手可及的人间奇迹

programme.title: 两岸一味第一季第二季The Flavourful Link Across the Strait S1 S2
programme.desc: 以街头巷尾的民间味道为联结，追溯两岸美食的中华渊源，讲述两岸故事，共鸣情感与文化六大主题版块，30种两岸吃食，60组人文故事，用两岸一脉共生的食之味，展现两岸一根同源的人情味，讲述两岸饮食的人间烟火，追寻中华民族的味觉乡愁

As she and ambitious magistrate Wen tackle difficult youth cases, they balance justice, compassion and redemption.

programme.title: 夏日奇妙书My Marvellous Fable
programme.desc: 实习编辑冯天蓝加入出版社的第一份任务就是去催畅销作家王葡萄的稿件，而她交稿的条件就是让冯天蓝从北京开车送她回老家琼海！在回乡的旅程中，王葡萄开始说一些真假参杂的故事，冯天蓝在整理书稿中拼凑出了王葡萄的人生，而王葡萄也在创作中反思自我两个心中有伤的人展开了互相治愈的浪漫奇幻之旅

programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time
programme.desc: 台湾小镇纸艺师阿松性格固执，与家人关系紧张，人生陷入了停滞某天，来自明朝的神秘女子阿暖突然出现成为他的徒弟，打破了他的平静生活一段相处后，两人发现彼此有跨越三百年的命运牵连在阿暖的影响下，阿松逐渐改变，学会面对情感与家庭，也与她产生了深刻连结故事融合了传统文化奇幻与成长，是一段关于改变与归属的温暖旅程Song, a stubborn paper artisan in a small town, leads a stagnant life until Nuan, a mysterious woman from the Ming Dynasty, appears as his apprentice. programme.title: 夏日奇妙书My Marvellous Fable

programme.title: 正义女神Themis
programme.desc: 言惠知因一宗少年案放弃晋升高院机会，转任少年法庭裁判官，也因此与丈夫离婚她坚持不枉不纵，在惩罚与救赎之间守护公义，赢得法院上下敬重立志成为最年轻高院法官的郑邵文因她的到来仕途受阻面对连串少年罪案，两人在理念碰撞中，携手帮助迷途少年重返正轨After a life-changing juvenile crime case, Zhi leaves a fast-track High Court career for the Juvenile Court, costing her marriage. programme.title: 阿松与阿暖Our Town, Her Time

programme.title: 百味人生Bittersweet Destiny
programme.desc: 百味人生是一部以料理为引线，交织情感人性与台湾文化的原创戏剧故事围绕一位总舖师因为一宗陷害事件，使其女儿与五位徒弟从分崩离析到彼此纠葛，呈现横跨25年的恩怨情仇与家族纠结剧中每一段故事，都对应一道人生滋味，展现爱情的甜亲情的苦背叛的辣梦想的酸与欲望的咸，融合台湾人饮食文化与庶民记忆，勾勒出在生命里最熟悉的味道与情感，透过时代转变与两代间的冲突，诉说成长与和解的历程，是一部结合文化深度与情感张力的戏剧Bittersweet Destiny is a Taiwanese original series that uses cuisine as the connecting thread to weave together themes of emotion, human nature, and Taiwanese culture. programme.title: 凡人修仙传The Immortal Ascension
programme.desc: 该剧改编自忘语的同名小说，讲述了一个普通的山村穷小子，偶然之下跨入一个江湖小门派，虽然资质平庸，但依靠自身努力和合理算计最后修炼成仙的故事Han Li, a poor boy from an ordinary mountain village, stumbles into the pugilistic world by chance. programme.title: Super Shark Highway Season 1
programme.desc: Follow the southern team as they test new migration tech and tools that could reduce shark attacks in a popular snorkelling spot. Then catch and tag bull sharks with the northern team, who want to help local swimmers steer clear of birthing mothers.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Shadow vet Bec, who patches up dog-bitten koala Rachel, and new vets Ruby and Kerryn, who soothe a pack of itchy possums. Free a pair of kookaburras trapped in a wall with rescue officer Dani and watch vet Tims squirrel glider knee surgery.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias Wild West Season 1
programme.desc: Avoid scaly and feathery dangers with wallabies, see koolamana lizards battle for mates, and feast with crocodile hatchlings. Brave dangerous rapids and understand the cultural and biological importance of a local river as the rainy season arrives.

programme.title: The Kimberley: Australias Wild West Season 1
programme.desc: Battle for dominion over the river with crocs, then catch glimpses of an ultra-rare mangrove snake and an endangered nabarlek wallaby. Take to the ocean to see humpback whale mothers raise their calves, then be hunted by false killer whales.

programme.title: Chasing the Rains Season 1
programme.desc: Trail Anastasia as her herd splits to protect two precious elephant calves, while Kuleta retakes territory for her remaining cheetah cubs. Join wild dog Phoenixs search for a new mate as the skies open up and rain begins to heal the parched land.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: See Amanda and Sophie push boundaries to get a vervet monkey with a broken leg back into the wild, the team is challenged when collaring a four-ton elephant. Alma receives an orphaned, cat-like genet and an antisocial baboon rejoins a troop.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the teams plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists.

programme.title: City Wildlife Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: See staff care for baby bunnies injured in a dog attack and then join the centers release team as they introduce an abandoned cygnet to an adoptive mother swan, and find that things dont go exactly as planned.

programme.title: Malawi Wildlife Rescue Season 1
programme.desc: See Amanda and Sophie push boundaries to get a vervet monkey with a broken leg back into the wild, the team is challenged when collaring a four-ton elephant. Alma receives an orphaned, cat-like genet and an antisocial baboon rejoins a troop.

programme.desc: Join the rescue as Amanda and Mandy try every trick in the book to help a snared hyena, a lion threatens a village, and the teams plan to release a troop of 13 monkeys is thwarted by last minute surgery and some crafty escape artists.

programme.title: Planet Shark Season 1
programme.desc: Follow a host of sharks with extraordinary abilities that allow them to thrive in the most adverse conditions around the globe. Observe nearly blind Greenland sharks made for life in freezing Arctic waters, and another species that can walk on land.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Experience animal abilities that are beyond human reach. See how saltwater crocodiles detect the tiniest movement with their pressure-sensitive domes, discover a pigeons internal GPS system, and use a seventh sense to detect prey with dolphins.

programme.title: Superbeast Season 1
programme.desc: Deploy biochemical weaponry with natures most cunning and resilient fighters. Unleash venomous bites with Komodo dragons, resist poisonous foes with mongoose mobs, and see birds use bone-crushing force to counter poisonous attacks.

programme.title: The Oceans Greatest Feast
programme.desc: Get a front-row seat to the planets biggest biomass migration, the annual 1,000-mile sardine run along South Africas east coast. See billions of these tiny fish run a gauntlet of hungry predators, including stealthy seals and dive-bombing gannets.

programme.title: Wildlife ER Season 2
programme.desc: Chase the team as they triage patients from a hoarding case, then free a tangled-up ibis with rescue officers Jo and Chantelle. Check on a baby koala that took a swan dive with vet Mel and play the waiting game with a deadly eastern brown snake.

programme.desc: Look behind the scenes and meet the innovative teams working to preserve and protect Kenyas wildlife. Check out Save the Elephants radio-tracking-collar system, a drone that monitors wild dog packs, and a local team of Maasai cheetah trackers.

programme.desc: Episod 7 membawakan kunjungan ke Durian Bikers Usha Kedai melihat perkembangan komunitinya, kunjungan ke Kidal Custom Shop Gegar Garage, dan sesi Borak Motorkar yang nostalgik mengenai legenda jalanan Saya bersama Yaj.

programme.title: CELEBS DAY OFF
programme.desc: Saksikan bagaimana seorang selebriti mengisi hari cuti mereka dengan bermacam aktiviti-aktiviti menarik. Dihoskan oleh Asmawi, anda akan mengenali lebih lanjut kisah kehidupan dan karier tetamu undangan kali ini, Intan Serah.

programme.title: AROMA MASAK
programme.desc: Hani Fadzil selaku hos musim ini akan menyediakan 2 menu istimewa iaitu Ayam Thai Cucur Manis sambil ditemani oleh ar3s jemputan, Faruq Suhaimi.

programme.title: DESTINASI BAJET
programme.desc: Dengan bajet yang minimum untuk penginapan, makan minum dan cenderahati untuk tiga hari dua malam ikuti pengembaraan cara destinasi bajet. Bersama Zetty Nabila, ikuti pemgembaraan ke Pulau Langkawi.

programme.title: KLTV 2026
programme.desc: Sebuah rancangan informasi yang memfokuskan tentang dunia hiburan di Malaysia dari pelancaran music wayang terbaru, isu isu panas terkini dan juga rancangaSiri best untuk dilayan.

programme.title: Purnama
programme.desc: Selepas Perang Dunia Kedua, Purnama mempertaruhkan nyawanya menentang ancaman komunis demi melindungi kampungnya. Namun, pengorbanannya mencetuskan rasa iri hati Yamin, yang akhirnya membawa kepada tragedi berdarah, mengorbankan Aminah dan mengakhiri persahabatan mereka.

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Haziq meminta kebenaran dari Iskandar untuk membawa Aisyah berjalan di shopping mall. Tidak mahu di anggap buruk lagi, Iskandar mengizinkan Haziq membawa Aisyah yang sudah 4 bulan tidak keluar dari kondo mewah itu. Keizinan yang diberikan oleh Iskandar itu memakan perasaannya sendiri, dia tidak tahu mengapa dia harus pergi memeriksa Haziq yang keluar berduaan dengan Aisyah. Malangnya, kepala Iskandar terasa berat, badannya terasa panas dan tidak mampu untuk bergerak ke shopping mall yang besar itu. Aisyah bersama Haziq berjalan ke kedai buku. Aisyah sering bercerita pada Haziq tentang minatnya terhadap novel dan Haziq telah menghadiahkan Aisyah beberapa novel sebagai peneman masa sunyinya. Kepulangan Aisyah ke kondo mewah itu pada lewat petang mengejutkan Aisyah apabila melihat Iskandar berada di ruang tamu dalam keadaan lemah. Aisyah berhati-hati menyentuh badan Iskandar yang panas. Aisyah segera pergi ke dapur dan menyediakan makanan yang bersesuaian dengan keadaan Iskandar serta menjaga baik Iskandar. Lima hari terdampar sakit, demam yang panas membuatkan hubungan Iskandar dan Aisyah seakan rapat dan perasaan yang mencuit bahagia.

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan tidur bermimpikan Antasya. Dia tidak lagi gelisah dan tidur meracau. Syafinaz berasa pelik. Apabila ditanya, Syarfan enggan bercerita kepada dirinya dengan lebih lanjut. Syarfan cuba mendekati Antasya bagi mengenal gadis tersebut. Namun Antasya mengendahkan dirinya. Ali mengupah orang bagi mengintip Antasya dan terkejut apabila mengetahui Antasya anak kepada Razali.

programme.title: Sudirman Chow Kit Road
programme.desc: Sudirman Chow Kit Road! merupakan sebuah dokumentari yang mengupas perjalanan dan kenangan nostalgia seorang lelaki berbadan kecil tetapi mempunyai jiwa yang besar, Sudirman Haji Arshad untuk mengadakan konsert percuma yang menyatukan rakyat malaysia berbilang kaum di tengah tengah jalan Chow Kit dan ianya merupakan satu fenomena besar suatu ketika dahulu, sehinggakan ianya masih terpahat di hati rakyat Malaysia

programme.title: Ekspresi Fesyen
programme.desc: Ekspresi Fesyen minggu ini host Aqilah Azali akan berbual fesyen bersama Mawi dari kumpulan Masdo. Akan berkenalan dengan pereka kasut dari perfect duo juga kita akan disajikan dengan segala macam info yang menarik tentang Fesyen.

programme.title: Ijab Kabut
programme.desc: Athira sudah tahu yang Deanna putus tunang! Demi untuk menyelamatkan keadaan, Deanna melaksanakan satu rancangan untuk membuat Khai jatuh cinta padanya dalam waktu yang singkat.

programme.desc: Dokumentari istimewa ini membawa penonton melihat misi menghasilkan mushaf naskhah al-Quran bertulis tangan untuk percetakan al-Quran di Malaysia. Ia berkongsi tentang proses penerbitan dan penerbitan al-Quran yang perlu melalui pelbagai peringkat tapisan.

Pun begitu, layanan Iskandar pada Aisyah kian berubah. Dia tidak lagi memarahi Aisyah malah hanya mendiamkan diri jika ada kesalahan yang dilakukan Aisyah. Namun dia tidak mampu meluahkan rasanya atas sebab jawatan CEO yang diimpikannya selama ini. Kebetulan pada hari itu, Tengku Maria datang ke kondo itu juga, Tengku Maria terkejut melihat seorang gadis berada di dalam kondo mewah milik anaknya.

programme.title: Ijab Kabut
programme.desc: Tindakan Mat telah membuatkan keadaan menjadi lebih keruh. Khai muncul kembali dan ketiga-tiga mereka harus mencari cara untuk memusnahkan perkahwinan Mat dan Deanna sebelum ia menjadi realiti!

programme.title: Secebis Rindu
programme.desc: Reeza cuba cari sebab kenapa Rasya berubah tiba-tiba. Reeza nak jumpa keluarga Rasya. Reeza nak keluarga mereka kenal dengan siapa mereka berkawan. Reeza ajak Rasya jumpa mama Rasya dahulu. Rasya dalam dilema.

programme.title: Black S1 EP4
programme.desc: Sebagai tukaran dengan fail ayahnya, Lokman memujuk Sofia untuk bekerja dengannya dan menggunakan kuasa Sofia untuk memberitahunya mana-mana kliennya yang akan menemui ajal. Semasa menjalankan tugas, Sofia bertemu Black yang menyedari kuasa Sofia mungkin kunci untuk membantunya memburu 419. Namun, caranya yang kasar menjengkelkan Sofia dan dia mendapati dirinya tidak diendahkan. Demi memenangi semula hati Sofia, Black menyiasat kes tembakan yang melibatkan Malik untuk meyakinkan Sofia yang dia bukan punca Malik ditembak. Pendirian Sofia berubah menjadi agak lembut dan seterusnya bersetuju untuk membantu Black mendapatkan ingatannya semula. Namun keadaan menjadi rumit apabila Black mengungkai lebih banyak petunjuk tentang kematian Malik dan menyedari nyawanya dalam bahaya.

programme.title: Black S1 EP5
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh upahan sedang menjejakinya lalu Black menyedari masanya dalam badan Malik semakin suntuk. Dia mesti menamatkan misinya dengan cepat dan satu-satunya harapan yang dia ada adalah menyakinkan Sofia untuk membantunya. Dia terjumpa sebuah bilik rahsia di dalam rumah Malik di mana tersimpan barang-barang yang jelas sekali disorok oleh Malik. Sementara itu, Sofia nampak satu pembunuhan bakal berlaku yang mengganggu perasaannya sehingga merangsang dia untuk bertindak. Dia memujuk Black untuk pulang ke kampung halaman mereka di Seri Setia untuk menyiasat kes itu. Anehnya, penyiasatan Borhan ke atas kes Nurul Najwa juga membawanya ke Seri Setia. Di sana, dia ketemu semula rakan sekerja lamanya, yang menyimpan rahsia tentang kes dingin yang berlaku 20 tahun lalu.

programme.title: Spirit Whisker: The Revenant
programme.desc: Seorang anak sulung keluarga kaya yang telah meninggal dunia tiba-tiba hidup semula selepas seekor kucing hitam misteri melompat ke atas mayatnya, yang membawa kepada kelakuannya yang pelik dan ganas yang menyebabkan keluarga itu huru-hara dan menimbulkan rahsia gelap di kalangan mereka.

programme.title: Siku 12: Langkah Derhaka
programme.desc: Seorang bapa telah merahsiakan ilmu persilatan yang telah lama dipelajari daripada anaknya kerana sejarah hitam yang dilaluinya. Anaknya merupakan peninju Muay Thai dan atas desakan yang bertubi-tubi, bapa akhirnya mewariskan ilmu yang dikenali sebagai Jurus Siku 12 Langkah Derhaka kepada anaknya yang akan bertanding pada pertandingan terbuka Pendang Muay Thai 2021.

programme.title: Black S1 EP5
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh upahan sedang menjejakinya lalu Black menyedari masanya dalam badan Malik semakin suntuk. Dia mesti menamatkan misinya dengan cepat dan satu-satunya harapan yang dia ada adalah menyakinkan Sofia untuk membantunya. Dia terjumpa sebuah bilik rahsia di dalam rumah Malik di mana tersimpan barang-barang yang jelas sekali disorok oleh Malik. Sementara itu, Sofia nampak satu pembunuhan bakal berlaku yang mengganggu perasaannya sehingga merangsang dia untuk bertindak. Dia memujuk Black untuk pulang ke kampung halaman mereka di Seri Setia untuk menyiasat kes itu. Anehnya, penyiasatan Borhan ke atas kes Nurul Najwa juga membawanya ke Seri Setia. Di sana, dia ketemu semula rakan sekerja lamanya, yang menyimpan rahsia tentang kes dingin yang berlaku 20 tahun lalu.

programme.title: Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. programme.title: Assasins Target
programme.desc: Seorang wanita pembunuh beracun dalam misi pencarian dan pemusnahan terhadap seorang pemimpin spiritual yang misteri.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP15
programme.desc: Li membawa bomoh dan memulakan upacara memanggil hantu Wan Peah. Bomoh ini menggunakan ikan masin untuk memanggil lembaga Wan Peah keluar. Selepas terhidu bau ikan kering yang sangat kuat, ternyata Wan Peah muncul pergi mendapatkannya. Sebaik sahaja ternampak kelibat Wan Peah, Li, Ghani dan Yeh melarikan diri. Melihat aksi Wan Peah, bomoh terus pengsan. Oleh kerana cerita Wan Peah yang tiada penghujungnya, Cikgu Siti merancang untuk berpindah dari situ. Nurin enggan berpindah kerana dia sudah selesa dan jauh disudut hatinya tidak mahu berpisah dengan Yeh.

programme.title: The Equalizer S2 EP1
programme.desc: Ketika McCall mempertimbangkan untuk menamatkan kerjanya sebagai The Equalizer, dia ditarik balik apabila dia berhadapan dengan Detektif Marcus Dante sebagai pelanggan baharu yang memerlukan bantuannya untuk mencari sekumpulan perompak bank yang tidak dapat dikesan.

programme.title: Dabbe Bir Cin Vakasi
programme.desc: Rumah sebuah keluarga di Turki dirasuk roh jahat yang ingin membunuh manusia.

programme.title: Rampok
programme.desc: Seorang wanita bersenjata memasuki sebuah bank untuk merompak. Setelah semua orang dijadikan tebusan, CCTV dimatikan. Pasukan polis yang diketuai oleh Inspektor Natasya tiba untuk berunding dan berhubung dengan perompak. Selepas rundingan berjaya, tiga tebusan dibebaskan. Tanpa disedari oleh pihak polis, salah seorang tebusan yang dibebaskan adalah rakan kepada perompak dan perompak itu sendiri. Para perompak mempunyai kisah silam mereka sendiri yang memaksa mereka melakukan rompakan. Apakah kisah sebenar di sebalik tindakan mereka?

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain Haji Zul Ariffin, ketua Unit Tindakan Khas UTK yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian Nur Fazura, ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra Farid Kamil, yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie Izara Aishah dan Jiman Iedil Putra, Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.

programme.title: Once Upon A Time In China II
programme.desc: Tiba dengan kereta api di Guangzhou pada tahun 1895, ketiga-tiga mereka melawan pengikut White Lotus, yang ingin membunuh semua orang asing dan Mak Cik ke-13 yang comel dan berpakaian Eropah. Ia bukanlah pertarungan terakhir pakar kung fu Dr. Wong Jet Li.

programme.title: Repeaters
programme.desc: Tiga orang remaja berusia dua puluhan mendapati diri mereka berada dalam gelung masa yang mustahil, di mana setiap hari mereka terjaga pada hari yang sama menakutkan seperti hari sebelumnya.

programme.title: Wangi
programme.desc: Nor dan suaminya, Khuzairi tinggal di sebuah banglo bersama dua anak mereka. Selepas melahirkan anak kedua, Nor pulang ke rumah dan ibunya datang untuk menjaganya. Dia perasan bahawa pembantu rumahnya, Bella telah hilang. Bella seperti adik kepada Nor dan dia tinggal bersama mereka. Suaminya mengatakan bahawa Bella telah kembali ke Amsterdam untuk berkahwin. Nor mengesyaki dan tidak lama kemudian anak-anaknya mula mempunyai kelakuan luar biasa. Anak pertama mereka suka bercakap dengan dirinya sendiri dan tidur di tempat yang rawak suaminya menyembunyikan rahsia manakala seorang wanita tua sentiasa memberi amaran kepada Nor. Tanpa disedari oleh Nor, Bella yang hilang mungkin sedang mengintai di sudut gelap banglo itu.

programme.title: Misteri Wan Peah EP16
programme.desc: Bomoh mula memulakan upacara memanggil hantu Wan Peah. Pada ketika itu, Wan Peah sedang berehat di dalam rumah. Selepas terhidu bau ikan kering yang sangat kuat, dia terjaga dan terus mendapatkannya. Pintu rumah Wan Peah dibuka dan dia mula mengutip ikan-ikan kering yang tersusun hingga ke dalam hutan. Sebaik ternampak kelibat Wan Peah, bomoh memulakan membaca jampi mentera kononnya untuk menghalau roh jahat. Li, Ghani, Yeh, Cik Siti dan Aziz hanya melihat sahaja Wan Peah yang memandang pelik kearah mereka. Wan Peah menggeleng kepala langsung kembali pulang ke rumahnya.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan cool di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran Hantu-Hantu Dunia untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.title: Tipu Kanan Tipu Kiri
programme.desc: Rudy, seorang jejaka tampan yang memiliki segalanya, Isterinya bernama Wulan, seorang penyanyi terkenal di Indonesia. Malangnya dalam syarat kontrak rakamannya, Wulan tidak dibenarkan untuk berkahwin. Untuk menyembunyikan perkahwinan mereka, Rudy dan Wulan berpindah ke Malaysia. Pelbagai kejadian lucu berlaku akibat kekeliruan dan suasana kelam kabut yang terjadi akibat penipuan mereka berdua.

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.

programme.title: Anak Sarawak

programme.title: Gerak Khas 2.0

programme.title: Boneka

programme.desc: Kisah Amar, seorang doktor yang ditugaskan di sebuah hospital. Suatu hari, Amar bertemu dengan bekas gurunya, Cikgu Azman. Selepas bersara, Cikgu Azman disahkan menghidap penyakit kanser. Amar cuba merawat gurunya sebaik mungkin.

programme.title: Temen Kondangan
programme.desc: Putri yang sering menghadiri majlis perkahwinan seorang diri akhirnya menyewa seorang lelaki untuk menjadi teman menghadiri majlis. Namun, hubungan yang pada mulanya sekadar lakonan bertukar menjadi lebih rumit apabila perasaan sebenar mula muncul.

programme.title: 7 Days24 Hours
programme.desc: Mengisahkan pasangan suami isteri, Tania dan Tyo, yang terlalu sibuk dengan kerjaya sehingga hubungan mereka semakin renggang. Selepas kedua-duanya jatuh sakit dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital yang sama, mereka akhirnya mempunyai masa bersama selama 7 hari 24 jam untuk memperbaiki hubungan, memahami satu sama lain dan menghadapi masalah yang selama ini dipendam.

programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. Filem ini mengikuti usaha sukarelawan Bulan Sabit Merah Palestin yang cuba mengekalkan talian komunikasi dengannya sambil berusaha menghantar bantuan menyelamat. Sebuah kisah menyentuh hati tentang kemanusiaan, konflik dan harapan di tengah tragedi perang.

programme.title: Diari Abah
programme.desc: Rahmat dipulaukan oleh tiga anaknya, Annur, Zarif Zakuan, setelah berkahwin buat kali kedua dengan Ashikin, ibu tunggal anak satu. Anak-anaknya menganggap kematian ibu mereka, Khalijad berpunca daripada keputusan Rahmat berkahwin lain. Namun mereka semua tersedar apabila Ashikin telah menyerahkan sebuah diari kepada mereka bertiga setelah Rahmat meninggal dunia. Tercatat dalam diari itu bahawa segala duit yang dikirimkan setiap bulan digunakan abah mereka untuk mendirikan rumah anak yatim atas permintaan arwah ibu mereka dengan nama Rumah Anak Yatim Cik Khalijah.

programme.title: Aku Bukan Gila
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Andra yang pergi bercuti ke Wales dan bertemu dengan beberapa individu yang mengubah perjalanan hidupnya. Di sebalik kehidupan yang kelihatan normal, dia berdepan dengan trauma dan konflik berkaitan kesihatan mental yang mempengaruhi dirinya

programme.title: Ada Apa Dengan Dosa
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Aurora, seorang gadis berusia 19 tahun yang dibesarkan di Eropah oleh keluarga angkat bukan Islam. Selepas mengetahui asal-usul sebenar dirinya sebagai anak luar nikah, Aurora kembali ke Malaysia untuk mencari ibu bapa kandungnya. Dalam perjalanan tersebut, dia dibantu oleh Khaliq dan mula mengenali erti keluarga, agama serta berdepan dengan dosa silam yang menghantui ibu bapanya.

programme.title: One, Two, Trivia

Apabila tabiat buruk mereka menyebabkan mereka bertembung dan memukul teruk ahli geng Pink dan Purple, Tai dan Kun kemudian direkrut oleh ketua geng yang kagum dengan kemahiran mereka.

programme.title: THE UGLY
programme.desc: Dong-hwan wants to uncover the mystery behind his mothers death after her skeletal remains have been discovered. The long-buried memories of her co-workers reveal a hidden truth...
